notes: Sustained the subject-based pairing of the two jussives: גִּיל takes shall ... rejoice with Jacob and שָׂמַח takes shall be glad with Israel, since the lexemes overlap enough that the ASV's wording is not evidence of a crossing, and the medium confidence on both units correctly records that a lexeme-crossing analysis stays defensible.

Sustained added for Then (t021): the Hebrew apodosis is asyndetic with no waw, and unlike a supplied copula or the of of a construct chain, a discourse connective is not required by any construction, so no morpheme licenses it; the italicized and before Israel is likewise correctly added because no waw precedes יִשְׂמַח.

Verified the partition: all 16 source and 29 target IDs appear exactly once, and the three discontinuous units (Oh that ... were come around the subject, of ... people around his, shall ... rejoice around Jacob) each absorb only the English their own source item realizes.
